title: Smoke Keeper
description:
About the GameSmoke Keeper is a cozy first-person organizing simulator set in a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. The night's delivery has been scattered across the shop, and 4,316 boxes, cartons, tins, jars, pouches and accessories must be put back where they belong before morning. 

Every item carries a number, and every place on every shelf carries the matching engraved plate. Read the stock, find its bay and shelf, and turn complete chaos into perfect order.

GameplayPick stock up by the armful, cycle through the stack in your hands, and carry each piece to its correct place. The shop itself is your guide: gilt bay letters, shelf plates and a detailed plan help you navigate the building rather than follow a quest list.

Cigars are a job of their own. Find a key for a locked shipping case, open it, then pack each house's cigars by hand into its display boxes.

Make the Shop Your OwnIn Cozy mode, completed rows earn skill points. Unlock and improve helpful abilities including Quick Order, Target Hint, Spot Matches, Auto-Place and Batch Grab to make every route through the shop more efficient.

Prefer a challenge? Speedrun removes the help, starts the clock on your first step, and records your best time on the leaderboard.

Features• Sort 4,316 pieces of stock across one hand-built two-storey shop 

• Match every item to its numbered bay, shelf and display

• Unlock five efficiency skills in relaxed Cozy mode

• Pack cigars from locked shipping cases into their correct display boxes

• Race in Speedrun mode and compete for a faster finishing time

• Save your progress and return to the same night whenever you like

• Full controller support plus rebindable keyboard and mouse controls
description_short: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.
